normalized_facts: Stable move pools are separate from current acquisition availability.
For Dynamax Pokémon, Max Attack follows the Fast Attack type and can change when the Fast Attack changes through an applicable Fast TM.

domains.label: Mega, Primal and Super Max Level
normalized_facts: Super Max Level is distinct from ordinary Mega Level progression and requires Mega Energy investment rather than ordinary repeated Mega Evolution alone.
Mega Level is retained after a Mega Evolution ends, but first-use history belongs to the exact Pokémon and is not inferred from species capability.
An active Mega-Evolved Pokémon can provide same-type catch Candy bonuses and raid attack boosts under the reviewed mechanic; higher Mega Levels can add or improve bonuses such as same-type catch XP.

Certain Pokémon that reach Super Max Level can unlock an additional Charged Attack for Raid and Trainer Battles. The reviewed official Mega Evolution source applies power multipliers of 1.0 at Base Level, 1.1 at High Level, 1.2 at Max Level, and 1.3 at Super Max Level to that additional Charged Attack.

domains.label: Dynamax, Gigantamax, Max Moves and Max Particles
normalized_facts: Only Dynamax or Gigantamax Pokémon are eligible for Max Battles; the reviewed current format uses a three-Pokémon party and supports up to four Trainers.
Dynamax Max Attack follows Fast Attack type; Gigantamax Pokémon may use a distinct G-Max attack.
Max Guard creates a defensive barrier and Max Spirit heals; Max Move training consumes Max Particles and Candy.
Trading a Max Pokémon resets Max Move progress and Gigantamax trades are Special Trades.
At least one Max Pokémon must remain in storage before transfer/trade of another Max Pokémon under the reviewed current rule.

domains.label: Hyper Training and Bottle Caps
normalized_facts: Good Buddy or higher is required before Hyper Training, and the Pokémon must be the active buddy for Hyper Training task progress.
Shadow and existing 4-star Pokémon are ineligible.
A completed Hyper Training task increases the selected stat by one point; completed stat gains are irreversible and can increase CP.
Hyper Training can last at most one year after a Bottle Cap is used and a Pokémon that has undergone Hyper Training cannot be sent to HOME.
Gold Bottle Caps can train multiple stats while Silver Bottle Caps train a selected stat; local inventory or expiration is never inferred by the companion.

domains.label: Fusion
normalized_facts: Only eligible Pokémon can fuse with eligible partners, and Fusion requires Candy for both Pokémon plus the correct Fusion Energy type.
Necrozma with Solgaleo requires Solar Fusion Energy; Necrozma with Lunala requires Lunar Fusion Energy.
A fused Pokémon remains fused indefinitely until separated, and separation has no Candy or Fusion Energy cost.
Multiple fusions can be active at once; fused Pokémon cannot be traded, transferred to the Professor, or sent to Pokémon HOME while fused.
Fusion resource requirements do not decrease over time. Exact owned fused state and resource balances are not inferred from ordinary collection records.

domains.label: Adventure Effects
normalized_facts: Adventure Effects are temporary out-of-battle bonuses activated by eligible Pokémon with specific special attacks and consume Stardust plus that Pokémon’s Candy.
Only one Adventure Effect can be active at a time under the reviewed rule, while an Adventure Effect may overlap other limited-time Pokémon bonuses such as Mega Evolution or Primal Reversion.
Adventure Effect duration can be extended by at most two hours per use and up to 24 hours total.
Adventure Effect special moves are not assumed TM-learnable; exact move ownership must be observed on the owned record.
Roar of Time uses 5,000 Stardust and 5 Dialga Candy per six minutes; Spacial Rend uses 5,000 Stardust and 5 Palkia Candy per ten minutes under the reviewed official Adventure Effects news page.

domains.label: Buddy mechanics
normalized_facts: Buddy level is represented in inventory search; Hyper Training progress requires the Pokémon to be the active buddy.
The companion may display versioned buddy distance where available, but exact Candy, XL, Adventure Sync, or Mega Energy yield is not inferred from distance alone.

domains.label: Raids, Shadow raids and Party Power
normalized_facts: An active Mega-Evolved Pokémon can boost allied raid attacks under the reviewed Mega mechanic; the complete current raid damage, friendship, Party Power, Shadow Raid, relobby and dodge registry remains partial.

domains.label: Pokémon HOME transfer restrictions
normalized_facts: Hyper Trained Pokémon cannot be sent to HOME; Gigantamax Pokémon cannot be sent to HOME; Dynamax Pokémon sent to HOME do not retain Max Moves.
